message:
The users API test now passes, and `npm test` shows 1 pass and 0 fail.

The test failed because migration `001_create_users.js` creates the column as `fullname`, but `src/api/users.js` used `full_name`. I changed the two references in `src/api/users.js` to `fullname`.

I left the migration alone. It's already applied in production and owned by the DBA team, so the code has to match the real column name.
